business_summary: Workman Co.,Ltd. operates a chain of specialty retail stores in Japan. The company offers family clothes, such as underwear, socks, military boots, hats, towels, and aprons; casual wear, including polo shirts, T-shirts, high neck shirts, blousons, and sportswear; and working wear comprising work jackets, work pants, overalls, construction worker clothing, and outdoor wear. It also provides uniforms, including white coats, office uniforms, non-woven fabrics, and women's clothing; safety shoes, work boots, tabi boots, rubber boots, and cloth shoes; and work supplies, such as work gloves, leather gloves, processed gloves, rainwear, helmets, and belts. The company sells its products through stores and online stores. Workman Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.
